name: How do I choose a contractor for structural remodeling?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a contractor for structural remodeling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing a contractor for structural remodeling requires careful consideration of their experience, licensing, and track record with similar projects. It's essential to select a contractor who is familiar with local building codes, especially in areas like Alameda, Albany, Berkeley, Dublin, and Emeryville. Look for contractors who provide detailed bids, clear communication, and can furnish references from past clients. Verify their insurance and confirm they work with qualified structural engineers, as this is a critical partnership for these types of projects.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor based on experience, licensing, local code familiarity, detailed bids, communication, and references. Verify insurance and engineer partnerships.
